definition: The theory that all living organisms are composed of cells, cells are the smallest unit of life, and new cells are produced from existing cells.

paper1.question: Which statement is part of cell theory?
options: Cells are the smallest unit of life
Cells are produced from non-living matter
paper1.answer: Cells are the smallest unit of life

definition: An organism that consists of only one cell.

paper1.question: What is a unicellular organism?
options: An organism consisting of one cell
An organism with many specialized cells
paper1.answer: An organism consisting of one cell

definition: An organism that consists of many cells that are specialized to perform different functions.

paper1.question: Why do multicellular organisms have specialized cells?

definition: A specialized structure within a cell that performs a specific function.

paper1.question: What is an organelle?
options: A specialized structure inside a cell
paper1.answer: A specialized structure inside a cell

definition: An organism whose cells do not contain a nucleus or membrane-bound organelles.

paper1.question: Which feature is found in prokaryotic cells?
options: A nucleus surrounded by a membrane
DNA located in a nucleoid region
paper1.answer: DNA located in a nucleoid region

definition: An organism whose cells contain a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles.

paper1.question: Which feature is characteristic of eukaryotic cells?
options: DNA only in a nucleoid region

definition: A selectively permeable barrier surrounding the cell that controls the movement of substances into and out of the cell.

paper1.answer: Controls movement of substances into and out of the cell

They allow living cells to be observed easily
